title: Build bounded local response actions from two actual nonlinear forward calls
statement: For native F:R^n->R^n, fixed x, unit q and allowed0<h<=hmax, supplied ||D^3F(z)[q,q,q]||2<=M3 on every probe segment and forward report error<=delta give zhat=(Fhat(x+h*q)-Fhat(x-h*q))/(2*h), with ||zhat-DF(x)*q||2<=M3*h^2/6+delta/h. Each response action costs TWO actual forward calls. With separately justified symmetry and norm-ball prior, this feeds a sound scalar-task upper certificate.

requires: A fixed stable native forward source and a permitted full +/-h*q segment for each actual real probe.
Independently justified uniform third-directional-derivative and native report-error bounds. For the symmetric compiler additionally justify DF(x) symmetry and its full norm-ball contract.
provides: For native F:R^n->R^n, fixed x, unit q and allowed0<h<=hmax, supplied ||D^3F(z)[q,q,q]||2<=M3 on every probe segment and forward report error<=delta give zhat=(Fhat(x+h*q)-Fhat(x-h*q))/(2*h), with ||zhat-DF(x)*q||2<=M3*h^2/6+delta/h. Each response action costs TWO actual forward calls. With separately justified symmetry and norm-ball prior, this feeds a sound scalar-task upper certificate.
assumptions: A valid reduction supplies an upper certificate, not native nonlinear minimax sharpness or a measured derivative channel.
The optimal h formula assumes positive M3 and delta and addresses only the stated bound; other regimes/instruments need separate analysis.
costs: k synthesized vector actions consume2*k forward calls and2*k*n coordinates, plus input preparation, arithmetic and calibration. No uncharged native Jacobian is granted.
contract.units: h has input units, M3 output/input^3, delta output, and effective action error output/input in the declared normalized coordinates.
contract.obstruction: Acquire actual stable smoothness, symmetry, allowed segments and error laws before assigning experimental precision to the compiler.

body: Subtract Taylor expansions and bound both forward errors; truncation contributes M3*h^2/6 and observation error delta/h. For positive M3,delta, this certificate is minimized at min(hmax,(3*delta/M3)^(1/3)); this is not a global optimum over nonlinear experiments. Feed the acquired action error to the signed-spectrum decoder. The abstract vector minimax LOWER bound does not transfer to the richer/constrained nonlinear source class, whose transcripts may admit other procedures. Rounding real steps/probes requires recalculating the certificate. Neither a symmetry/gradient-source law nor a uniform derivative/error calibration is inferred from old pointwise values.

evidence.range_scope: Actual two-forward reduction and upper-certificate scope, plus producer-reported nonlinear workload example without replay.
evidence.quote: ## 5. A compiler for native nonlinear *forward* experiments
evidence.status: Exact frozen source bytes; scientific acceptance is scoped to actual version-bound review.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed author reconstruction of the signed spectral q/y procedure, dual/inertia lower bound and deterministic central adaptive branch; exact Loewner support transformation and outer-family limitation; two-forward Taylor/error certificate; C5 strongly convex finite-gradient-history bump; and true scalar-readout equality with off-task/universal-information loss. Full governing note, complete response and all four scripts were statically read. Selected certificate/error/observation/failure fields in all four supplied JSONs were inspected; full raw matrices and every numerical claim were not independently verified or replayed. Source contracts are supplied; primary novelty, calibration, devices and physical advantage remain open.
